_notes.roles: Peaux (215 px) slams Barry (240 px). Same frame structure and conventions as the approved Barry-slams-Peaux v5 set with the roles swapped.
_notes.scale: Pair frames S1/S3 and R1/R3 share one factor (0.345; P1 is an edit of the lock-up source drawn at 700 px for Barry = 240/700) so contact points line up; singles scaled to the stand sprites (S4 0.2646, S5 0.2452, R4 0.2363, R5 0.2532, R6 0.2604, R7 0.2509). 60 PPU. pb5b: P2 (pb5b_p2_a) factor 0.318 (Peaux boot area matched to the P1/P3 average; Peaux 211 px tall in S2 vs 212 in S1); R4 (pb5b_r4_b) factor 0.232 (body-mass match to the previous R4/R5). S1/R1 (pb5b_p1_n) factor 0.309 (Peaux boot area matched to the approved S2 source). pb5c: S1/R1 factor 0.276, S2/R2 0.236 (the edits zoomed in; matched by Peaux's stance width: 131/115 and 134/117 px vs 132/115 in pb5b S2), R6 0.26 (between the previous R6 and the R7 body mass).
_notes.pair_spacing: S1/R1 and S3/R3 drawn with Peaux feet and Barry root 132 px apart; S1/R1 pivots moved 30 px toward the opponent (D-032/D-033) so the pair lines up at lockUpPairSpacing 1.2 (72 px).
_notes.pivots: Follows the PROMOTED v5 meta pivots: S1/S2 and R1/R2 = cell centre - 30; S3-S5 = cell centre (feet at the root, the 30 px shift taken during the S3 turn, D-044 follow-up); R3 = cell centre - 60; R4-R7 = bottom centre. pb5b: S2/R2 follow S1/R1 (cell centre - 30). S5 mirrored by script and recut on its feet centre (cell 182, pivot 91 = centre). R6 recut with its pre-fix bbox so cell 246x63, pivot 123 and root are unchanged (stays in register with R7).
_notes.flip: Peaux frames stored facing left; S1 unflipped while Peaux faces left (lock-up), S3-S5 drawn flipped (he faces the throw). R1/R3 stored facing left, flipped while Barry faces right. R4-R7 stored for a throw to screen-right (slammer on the left): unflipped while the throw goes right, flipped when it goes left. R5-R7 lie head-left (toward the slammer).
_notes.receiver_roots: R4-R7 root = slammer feet centre + root_offset_from_slammer_feet_px along the throw: the v5 values (178/340/382/382) scaled by 215/240 = 159/305/342/342 (342 = 1.59 x 215, the D-044 median). Suggested only; Combat/presentation own the real values. lowest_pixel_above_ground baked in as empty rows (R4 109 = 122 x 215/240, R5 20, R6 0, R7 17).
_notes.D-044: D-044 says Peaux slams Barry keeps its old no-throw behaviour until its own new art exists. This art is drawn as a throw (like Barry slams Peaux); whether the pb slam becomes a throw is a designer/Combat decision.
_notes.pb5b_changes: Redone: S1/R1 (new source pb5b_p1_n), S2/R2 (new), R4 (new source), S5 (script mirror), R6 (script leg removal). Unchanged and pixel-identical to pb5: S3, R3, S4, R5, R7.
_notes.real_gaps: Composite enclosed px are real see-through gaps cleared at source as flat-grey background pockets: S1+R1 1104 (between belly and Peaux, Barry's arm and torso), S2+R2 156 (between the slimmer belly and Peaux's scooping forearm), S3+R3 1268 (raised arms), R6 106 (between the legs; stand+R6 172 includes the stand sprite's own 66).
_notes.pb5c_changes: Redone from the designer corrections PDF (Staging/Art/wrestler/Peaux Slams Barry Corrections.pdf): S1/R1 (pb5c_p1_g + scripted 10% gut trim on the R1 layer), S2/R2 (pb5c_p2_c), R6 (pb5c_r6_a, regenerated). Unchanged and pixel-identical: S3, R3, S4, S5, R4, R5, R7.
_notes.final: Final, designer-approved 2026-11-17 and promoted: Peaux (slammer) S1-S5 = Assets/Art/Wrestlers/Peaux/peaux_bodyslam5_1..5.png; Barry (slammed) R1-R7 = Assets/Art/Wrestlers/Barry/barry_bodyslammed5_1..7.png. art_version says which pass each frame comes from (pb5 = first pass, pb5b = second, pb5c = third, from the designer corrections PDF). Every cell size above was checked against the promoted file. Not yet done (Unity Animation & Tooling): import settings, pivots, slicing, clips. Old v3 peaux_bodyslam.png / barry_bodyslammed.png untouched.
_notes.fields: cell = [w,h] px; pivot_px_from_left = sprite pivot x; pivot_dx = pivot offset from the cell centre (-30 lock-up shift toward the opponent for S1/S2/R1/R2, -60 for R3); ground_px_from_bottom = 0 for pair/slammer frames (soles on the bottom row); lowest_pixel_above_ground = baked lift rows for R4-R7 (empty rows at the bottom, pivot = bottom centre); root_offset_from_slammer_feet_px = suggested receiver root along the throw for R4-R7; flip_when_* = flip rules (see flip note).
